WorkspaceSnapshot.title: WorkspaceSnapshot
WorkspaceSnapshot.description: Cloud backup and workspace synchronization document for a PLUTUS Cable Production System user.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the workspace owner.

ownerEmail.description: Verified email address of the workspace owner.

payloadJson.description: Serialized JSON snapshot of the user's orders, stock ledger, container plans, and settings.

orderCount.description: Total number of orders in the snapshot.

updatedAtIso.description: ISO-8601 timestamp string of the client snapshot.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the workspace document was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the workspace document was last updated.

/workspaces/{userId}.description: Per-user workspace snapshot document keyed by the user's Firebase Auth UID.
